bootstrap.unit: paired independent new day conditional on fixed historical input

interpretation: Old32 paths are development only and excluded. Three selected historical conditions reported separately. Native-bank complete recovery was the locked primary outcome; all pairwise statistical comparisons are exploratory. Recovery intervals use conservative exact paired-proportion bounds; weight intervals use paired percentile bootstrap. p values are unadjusted for multiple policies.

old_gamma2_vs_no_dfs.recovery_exact_interval_method: Gain and loss multinomial proportions each receive a97.5% Clopper-Pearson interval; subtract opposite endpoints. Bonferroni joint coverage at least95%, conservative.
old_gamma2_vs_no_dfs.failure_handling: Missing or failed AC rows count as nonrecovery; mean weights use explicitly counted complete pairs.

old_gamma2.time_scope: Driver wall time includes initial construction, scalar rejection threshold, model construction and native solving.
